name: tests-only-gotenberg-structured-process-incident-diagnostics
instr:
Expose process diagnostics and attach completed backend reports to supervised launch and shutdown errors. Preserve the originating cause through errors.Is and ProcessIncidentError.Unwrap; Report returns the supplied report and Error returns a nonempty message. Preserve diagnostic operation, kind, identity, summary and remedy when wrapping reports.

Real Chromium and LibreOffice start failures return *ProcessIncidentError with a nonempty ID and ProcessDiagnosticStart kind. Their Summary, Remedy and Operation omit private filesystem paths. Caller-visible reports retain safe remedies without copying command output, private addresses, environment values or profile paths from backend errors.

Record repeated supervised failures once each with distinct supplied IDs, newest first. Incidents returns independent snapshots. Later successful launch does not alter an already-returned report. An unhealthy restart returns the replacement launch incident and cause rather than a shutdown warning.

An unconfigured &gotenberg.ProcessMock invokes StartMock, StopMock and HealthyMock normally; Diagnostics returns no report and an empty ID, including concurrent reads. Cancellation and queue rejection preserve their error identities and leave history empty. Ordinary task errors retain their cause without gaining incidents.

HTTP incident errors preserve status and message, set `Gotenberg-Process-Incident-ID` to that response's ID, and append ` Process incident ID: <id>.`, including concurrent respo
